decision_basis.advisory_type: AI role-based written advisory; no native-speaker or independent-expert participation

identity.core_definition_ko: 조금 피곤하고 조금 서툴지만, 자기만의 속도로 하루를 살아가는 어른.
identity.visual_age_direction: late 20s to mid 30s impression; exact age is not canon

vulnerabilities_ko: 작은 일에도 잠시 지칠 수 있다
avoid_ko: 차 한 잔이 모든 문제를 해결하는 연출

audience.primary_hypothesis_ko: 일본 25~39세 여성 직장인 및 1인 생활 경험자
audience.secondary_hypothesis_ko: 성별에 관계없이 일상 유머와 작은 회복에 공감하는 성인

visual.style: minimal everyday motiontoon; warm paper, restrained brown lines, expression-led

hair.shape: fixed short bob and asymmetric fringe

hairpin.position: character's left / viewer's right in frontal view

visual.face: small eyes, simple mouth, restrained cheek blush

proportion.target_impression: adult stylized character; visual recognition still requires audience validation

wardrobe.default: mint knit top, long muted gray-green trousers, plain cream shoes
wardrobe.outside: optional plain cardigan and unbranded bag
wardrobe.sleep: optional long-sleeve loungewear in the same palette

japanese_voice.first_person: omit by default; use 私 only when the contrast needs it
japanese_voice.direct_address: avoid repeated lectures or commands to the viewer
japanese_voice.humor: light self-observation and small behavioral contrast
japanese_voice.emotional_tone: quiet realization; no forced motivational ending
japanese_voice.official_name_suffix: none; ちゃん is not a default suffix

production.line_break_policy: semantic wrapping with Japanese kinsoku checks; do not use a fixed character count as acceptance proof
